hypothesis: Strengthening gait phase regularity (from -1.0 to -2.5) will reduce gait CV metrics toward the healthy range (<0.15). Simultaneously loosening shoulder pitch tolerance (0.15→0.35) and increasing the angular momentum penalty (−0.01→−0.05) will give arms the kinematic freedom and incentive to produce natural counterswing, improving overall gait appearance without destabilising the robot.
expected_effects: gait_air_cv_mean and gait_contact_cv_mean decrease (target: approach <0.15) — direct effect of stronger regularity penalty
track_linear_velocity reward decreases slightly — expected trade-off as policy allocates capacity to gait rhythm (Rule 6 check)
symmetry_vel_cost_mean improves — more periodic gait should reduce velocity asymmetry between legs
mean_ep_len remains stable or increases — stability already solved, these changes should not destabilise
landing_force_mean remains in 30–90 N range — no soft_landing weight change, should be unaffected
